criterion_selection.Enter_and_blur: Enter when nonempty/changed/no-error calls event.target.blur. Blur calls searchByKeyword with500ms throttle. Empty trimmed text resets default. Changed valid text resets committed/default data first, then invokes configured add_codes with action_target CHANGE and keyword. Selection/cancel details are delegated useCodeSearch/selector program.

Sets sort_prop={sid:prop_id,code:prop_id,name:display_name plus optional(alias_name)}, data_type and item_meaning_id. date/date_no/numeric/decimal selections reset page_separate_tf=false.

rows_and_order.initial3: Three rows are current UI evidence; minimum/default3 construction is in missing setup/default-record code and not established by these bodies.
rows_and_order.growth: InitializeSortConfig subscribes sort_prop. When criterion control is not excluded, every existing row has nonempty selected code, and current count<5, appends one default record with new sid and next sort_seq. initial_sync true means it may append on initial/full data. This is not a universal hard3row limit, and does not truncate larger supplied data.
rows_and_order.bulk_remove: BulkRemoveSortConfigUserAction replaces each selected row with abstract default record, preserving record_sid and sort_seq, then clears selected-row map. It resets selected rows rather than physically removing them in this implementation.
rows_and_order.up_down: No main SortConfig row up/down handler binding was found in these bodies. Apply follows current data-model array order and renumbers retained valid rows1..N. Do not infer drag/keyboard/row-move details.

field_enablement_and_direction.empty_criterion: sort_prop_data_type derived from selected code; asc_desc becomes writable iff type nonempty. Excluded fields become nonwritable; code fields use writable{code:false,name:false}.
field_enablement_and_direction.direction: asc_desc is preserved into outgoing sort records. This source does not supply the current 올림/내림 label options/default value, nor prove their exact A/D binding; those renderer attributes are dynamic setup.
field_enablement_and_direction.subtotal_line: Enabled only option.use_subtotal && page_lookup_type===A && nonempty data type in date/txt groups. Changing datatype sets subtot_tf to eligibility, and subtot_standard=M for eligible date elseN.
field_enablement_and_direction.page_split: Enabled only option.use_page_separate && nonempty txt-group data type && no earlier row date/numeric type. Selecting one page_separate_tf true clears it for all other rows. Any page split makes page_display_method writable; none disables it and sets scroll.
field_enablement_and_direction.settings_button: InitializeSortConfigUtils.isEnableSetup returns nonempty type && subtot_tf; subscriber sets setup.display_state. The source is display state rather than explicit enabled/disabled; exact current button rendering depends on setup.

apply_and_submenus.apply_contract: ApplySortConfig keeps only rows with nonempty sort_prop.code; maps asc_desc/count_mark_tf/page_separate_tf/sort_prop+type+meaning/subtotal flags, reassigns sort_seq1..N, includes page_display_method. It marks left-fixed cancellation when option.use_left_fixed && option.is_left_fixed && any selected row.subtot_tf.
apply_and_submenus.validation: apply_validate may confirm left-fixed cancellation if message.use_left_fixed and cancellation flag are both true; the local constructed message does not populate use_left_fixed. trx_bal_status additionally requires date criterion last and not sole criterion, and at least one configured sum-item meaning; unrelated current report validation not inferred. Candidate request excludes duplicate choices, but no general duplicate validator is in this Apply helper.
apply_and_submenus.apply_success: After validation, optionally saves, then vmc.sendMessage(message) and vmc.closePage. Empty filtered list has no general rejection here (special trx_bal_status validation can block); it can send data=[]. No result query is called directly in ApplySortConfig; parent receiver decides subsequent search/redraw.
